summary: Slider's ROOT now carries data-slot="slider", like every other control's, so an effect applied through className can reach its parts (ADR 0022: `fx("aurora")` paints the track fill). The header row above the track, which held that slot name without being documented, is now data-slot="slider-header". Both are in slider.doc.ts's anatomy.

migration.manual: A selector or test that targeted the header row by [data-slot="slider"] — the label and value line above a track Slider — now targets [data-slot="slider-header"]. [data-slot="slider"] now matches the whole control. Copies of slider.tsx: add "data-slot": "slider" to BaseSlider.Root's props and rename the header row's slot.
